issue.title: test_project_labels_never_derive_from_paths fails: repair_archived_prompt_path derives Path(project_file).parent.name
issue.description:
Proposed by sase-1lj.2 (note #3) and corroborated by sase-1lj.3 (note #4) while working
epic sase-1lj; triaged and filed by the sase-1lj land agent.

`tests/test_project_display_presentation_audit.py::test_project_labels_never_derive_from_paths`
fails deterministically on master f6ff20ef2a (reproduced in isolation by the land agent):

```
AssertionError: src/sase/ace/tui/actions/hints/_view_target_repair.py:repair_archived_prompt_path derives Path(project_file).parent.name
```

Root cause: a9701c36e6 ("feat(ace): resolve logical plan hint targets", plan
`202610/v_hint_logical_plan_targets.md`, no bead) added
`repair_archived_prompt_path`, which computes
`project_key = Path(project_file).parent.name` to locate the project's agents sidecar
clone (`hidden_sidecar_clone_dir(project_key, AGENTS_SIDECAR_ROLE)`). That is an
identity use, not a display label, but the audit
(`tests/_project_display_presentation_audit_path_labels.py`) flags every
`project_file`-derived path expression under `src/sase/ace/tui/` that is not in
`_PATH_LABEL_EXEMPTIONS`.

Fix: route the key through the canonical project-key helper the other identity sites use
(for example `project_file_parent_name`) if one exists, or add a reviewed
`_PATH_LABEL_EXEMPTIONS` entry for this identity site, per decision
`project-labels-never-keys`. Do not weaken the audit.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic AST audit over source files: fails in isolation on every run on master f6ff20ef2a and on the clean base trees sase-1lj.2 and sase-1lj.3 stashed back to; introduced by a9701c36e6.

issue.creation_reason: Two sase-1lj phase agents hit this deterministic audit failure on an unchanged base tree and no task tracked it; the land agent reproduced it on master.

payload.description: Adjacent project-labels-never-keys defect: project_display_label prefers a project_file-derived key; keep the presentation audit green when fixing either
